title: Thick curtain
text:
Thick curtain. This is a good shower curtain, it is a nice weight- definitely not flimsy.
But the color is way off from what is advertised.

product_metadata.title: Shower Curtain Liner Teal- Bathroom Shower Curtains Plastic With Magnets Weighted Waterproof Heavy Duty Shower Liner EVA 10 Gauge 72" * 72" 12 Shower Curtain Hooks Included PVC Free Teal Shower Liners
features: A multifunctional shower curtain liner can be used a lone as a shower curtain or accompany with fabric shower curtain as a waterproof liner. The 3d Bubble design with 100% EVA material can be a see through shower curtain but no 100% visible. People outside can see the shape but no details

Waterproof shower curtain is made of 10 Gauge EVA material, which is environmental friendly and odorless. We especially choose thick material and add 3 magnets weighted at the bottom to ensure the bathroom shower curtain goes down nicely

Shower liner is made of delicate details. The area to fix the rings are reinforced with rust proof metal grommets and additional double layer for protection is added. 12 C shaped shower curtain rings are included in the packaging, so customers can use the plastic curtain directly and also easily change the shower rings hooks that you like

Inner shower curtain liner is easy care and convenient to use. No machine wash. After shower, wipe it with damp cloth and keep it open and air dry. Size is 72"72". It is excellent for stall shower liner and bathtubs

Bath curtain is designed with teal color. Color is attractive and vivid to decorate your bathroom. The shower curtain liner is ideal for campers, home for master bathroom, guest bathroom, and kid's bathroom, apartments, schools showers, hotels, dorms, athletic club showers and many more. Package Included: 1 teal 3d shower curtain liner and 12 plastic C shape shower curtain hooks
description: Heavy duty EVA plastic shower curtain liner, PVC Free, Non Toxic, Odorless, Waterproof Bathroom Curtain for Bathtub or Shower Stall

Cozilar 3d shower curtain is made of heavy duty EVA material which is environmental friendly and odorless. Attractive 3d patterns with teal color decorates the bathroom vividly.Material is semitransparent which can let light through so that it brightens the hole environment but also can not totally see through which protects privacy.

♥Water resistant, no chemical smell,no odor, against squalor forming ♥Reinforced grommet header prevents tearing ♥72" * 72" size for both bathtub and install  ♥3 Magnets at the bottom  ♥Easy to clean and maintain
1 shower curtain for bathroom 12 shower curtain rings
